method_note: Each point is the single OneMap address-search feature for the address Keppel DC REIT's Annual Report 2025 gives for the facility. The served WGS84 latitude/longitude was re-derived from the served SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y with pyproj 3.7.1 / PROJ 9.5.1 (always_xy, EPSG:3414 -> EPSG:4326); differences are below 1e-8 m. A search for each postcode returned a byte-identical single result. No geocoding beyond the official address search, no offsets and no rounding were applied.
site_versus_campus_review: Keppel DC Singapore 2, 3 and 4 are treated as three separate physical sites. The annual report lists each with its own street number and postcode, its own leasehold land title (expiring 31 July 2051, 31 January 2052 and 30 June 2050), its own land area (53,821, 53,815 and 73,248 sq ft) and its own gross floor area; the 3Q 2026 table repeats the separate titles. Keppel DC Singapore 7 and 8, by contrast, are reported with a 'shared land area of whole campus'. The 25 and 27 address points are about 45 m apart (WGS84 geodesic 44.7 m); the 20 Tampines Street 92 point is about 182 m north-north-west of number 25 (geodesic 181.7 m). Distances listed per candidate are spherical haversine values. Atlas precedent keeps separately titled, separately named neighbouring properties as separate sites (SUNeVision MEGA Plus and MEGA IDC; iTech Tower 3.1 and 3.2).

candidates.precision_scope: Singapore Land Authority address point for the operator-stated address. It marks the building address, not a surveyed outline, entrance, land-lot boundary or data hall.
candidates.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: OneMap supplies no positional accuracy for address points; decimal places are not survey accuracy.
